profile.jobTitle: Full Stack Web Developer / MERN Stack Developer - Website Development & Website Management
profile.summary:
Dynamic, Resourceful, and Innovative are a few of the words said by my colleagues and clients for me. I am Maurya Patel, a Certified Full Stack Web Developer skilled in Web Development, Web Designing, MERN Stack Development, Application Development, Programming, and Computer Technology.

I am an Engineering student pursuing my bachelor’s degree in Computer Technology from the New Jersey Institute of Technology. Highly Skilled in Web Development with in-depth knowledge of programming languages: JavaScript ES6+, CSS3, HTML5, SQL, NoSQL, Tools: Express, React, Node, Handlebars, jQuery, Bootstrap, and Applications: GitHub, MongoDB, MySQL, Heroku, Firebase.

I love learning about new technologies and implementing them in my projects to enhance my skill set as a Web Developer. I always thrive to meet the specific requirement of clients beginning with the choice of the Model, Execution, and Completion. I love to dig into customer problems and solve them with modern technology. I create, scale, and optimize Web portfolios that matter.

✨ 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐍𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐚 𝐆𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐖𝐞𝐛𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐞?
Your website should guide potential customers towards your services. To do this, you need to speak their language and understand "why" they chose to do business with you and "what" pain you solve. Your website is the hub of all your marketing but is it simply informational, or does it work as a sales machine leading to purchases?

Don't let your website become another bland template. Your customers are looking for useful information that leads to a solution through the services you provide. 
It's simple, we want your business to grow, and we only agree to work together once we understand what it takes to bring you results.

✨ 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐈 𝐎𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫:
✅ WEBSITE DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT
✅ WEBSITE OPTIMIZATION & MANAGEMENT 
✅ APPLICATION DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT
✅ WEB PROJECT MANAGEMENT

✨ 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐌𝐞?
As a Full Stack Web Developer, I have excelled in developing customized potential websites based on specific requirements of the business, I will give your current business a polish and a shine through Web Development solutions.

✨ 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐎𝐮𝐭 𝐓𝐨 𝐌𝐞
Send me a private message on LinkedIn
Email me at mauryapatel12@gmail.com
Visit website: https://maurya512.github.io/new-portfolio/

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer / MERN Stack Developer - Website Development & Website Management
positions.description:
✅ I am a Certified Web Development Expert, Providing best-in-class Web Development services through a strong understanding of Languages (JavaScript ES6+, CSS3, HTML5, SQL, NoSQL) & Tools (Express, React, Node, Handlebars, jQuery, Bootstrap), Technology, industry trends, and content management systems.

✅ Providing Web Designing, Web Development, Web Optimization, Custom Web Design, Application Development, and MERN Stack Development Services. As a Web Developer, Responsible for both front-end and back-end development, including creating Website themes and plugins.

✅ Developing responsive, standard-compliant HTML and CSS3 themes for clients, from custom-created layouts and in-house designs. Evaluating designs, wireframes, and other deliverables during the design and user experience phase for potential development issues and flag problems appropriately.

✅ Conducting cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure consistent display in major supported browsers on Mac, PC, iOS, and Android platforms. Troubleshooting complex web development issues, acting as a subject matter expert both internally and externally with clients. 

✅ Designing and implementing new features and functionality, Establishing and guiding the website’s architecture, Ensuring high-performance, and managing all technical aspects of the CMS.

✅ Focusing on creating value for customers and making sure that the services are constantly evolving and changing with the times. Understanding customer needs, motivations, and behaviors to translate them into website design. Speaking directly with clients to collect feedback on milestone deliverables and implement them into the design.

✨ 𝐒𝐄𝐑𝐕𝐈𝐂𝐄𝐒 𝐈 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐕𝐈𝐃𝐄:
✅ WEBSITE DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT
✅ WEBSITE OPTIMIZATION & MANAGEMENT 
✅ APPLICATION DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT
✅ WEB PROJECT MANAGEMENT

✨ 𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐟𝐨𝐥𝐢𝐨 & 𝐖𝐞𝐛𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐞:
https://maurya512.github.io/new-portfolio/

positions.title: Licensed Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
Working in a highly technical and disciplined work environment that demands nothing short of perfection. Understanding written/electronic medication chart orders, deciphering prescription or drug orders sentences, and verifying orders received

Conveying information effectively to patients, coworkers, supervisors, and other healthcare professionals, Finishing given responsibilities before the due date, and respecting the client’s timeline. Sensitive towards other people’s needs and an ideal team player.

Performing work relating to administrative and clerical procedures such as data entry, managing electronic files and records, and other pharmacy policies and procedures. Developing and maintaining cooperative working relationships with patients, co-workers, supervisors, and other healthcare professionals.

Demonstrated the ability to address problems in a group setting using tools and techniques for the identification and resolution of problems. Provided courteous, cooperative, and timely service to patients, visitors, and team members; demonstrated good oral and written communication.

honors.title: Voted most likely to come up with out of solution while debugging a problem.
honors.description: I was awarded to be the one who's most likely to find out of the box ways to debug a problem by my fellow classmates and peers.
honors.issuer: Issued by Rutgers Coding Bootcamp · Oct 2020

honors.title: Awarded most likely to walk that extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
honors.description: Recognized by manager for commitment to customers and  for communicating with 150 or more customers per week.

volunteerExperiences.description: In the wake of COVID19 our pharmacy volunteered to administer Flu Shots Free of Cost. We had a Flu Clinic every week during the months of September and October. I was in charge of coordinating incoming patients to the Pharmacist to ensure that CDC guidelines were being maintained.
Our pharmacy had the good fortune of volunteering to hand out 100+ meals on Thanksgiving eve to the less fortunate people.

projects.title: E-commerce store
projects.description: In this project I am challenging myself to hone my basic skills, and really dive deep into creating a scalable E-Commerce Web Application from ground up. It will implement the MERN stack along with Paypal APIs for payment and will be mobile responsive as well. Stay tuned to see how it turned out.

projects.title: Fitness-Tracker
projects.description: In this app the user can track their workouts to keep their fitness streak in check. This app utilizes MongoDB Atlast to store the data in the backend along with NodeJS and Express. This app is deployed on Heroku.
